verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner: the can in its circle sits on the left, a large headline in the middle and badges plus CTA on the right, with clear hierarchy. However, the GLACIER wordmark floats centred above the headline column instead of lining up with its left edge, the badges and CTA are oversized and float in their own column away from the copy, and the far right margin is uneven. B stacks everything into one cramped left column, leaving roughly 45% of the canvas on the right as dead space. Its headline is shrunk so it barely outranks the body copy, the gaps are uneven (a big gap under the headline, then tight gaps between body, badges and CTA), and the CTA and circle crowd the bottom edge.
